criteria.reason: Never states the Art. 20a ArG rule (three days' notice, compensation, unpaid); cites non-existent anti-discrimination law instead.
Respectful throughout; acknowledges Eid's significance, no stereotyping or questioning of religiosity.
Proposes consensual arrangements: shift swaps, make-up hours, unpaid leave, external cover, documented agreements.
Refers to a Swiss labour-law specialist; disclaims providing legal counsel.

factual_errors: Cites a 'General Anti-Discrimination Act' covering religious belief; no such Swiss act governs employment religious leave.
Claims refusing the leave could constitute religious discrimination; Swiss law instead grants Art. 20a ArG leave with notice, unpaid unless made up.
Omits the three-day notice rule and the unpaid-unless-compensated rule entirely.
summary: Respectful and practical but legally inaccurate: omits the actual Swiss rule and cites non-existent discrimination law.
